method: Real production Chromium screenshots and native Playwright video. H.264 transcodes preserve the full original timing. Scrolling uses browser wheel input, including reverse scrolling. No application timeline seeking, injected styles or synthesized imagery. Full-page screenshots are taken after visiting the whole page. Software rendering is not a physical-device benchmark.
assetStatus: The owner-approved founders sketch and existing illuminated emblem-plaque.png are reused. The plaque is an approved separated raster prototype presented in layers, not an editable or newly rendered 3D model. The new brief authorizes this appearance. The original private photograph is not published.
